sources.source: Building Safety Remediation: monthly data release - May 2026
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_fact: At 31 May 2026 the management-information release tracked 4,411 residential buildings 11 metres and over identified with unsafe cladding. It reported 472 of 516 ACM buildings as having completed remediation and 500 as having started or completed works.
sources.quality_effect: Adds building-safety remediation context while retaining identified-versus-estimated-universe, programme, height, started-versus-completed, building-control-sign-off, self-reporting and revision guards; programme status is not a parcel-level fire-risk measurement.

sources.source: Drinking Water 2025: Chief Inspector's report for England
sources.verified_fact: The Chief Inspector's 2025 report states that 99.97% of regulatory samples from public water supplies met standards and covers compliance data, water-quality events, audits and emerging risks for supplies serving about 59.74 million consumers through 24 water companies.
sources.quality_effect: Adds drinking-water safety context while retaining regulatory-sample-versus-consumer, parameter, supply-zone, event, company, asset-condition and private-versus-public-supply guards; national compliance cannot be downscaled to a parcel without local supply evidence.

sources.source: Flood and coastal erosion risk management report: 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025
sources.verified_fact: The statutory national report, updated 30 June 2026, covers the year's flood and coastal context, current risk and investment, climate-resilient places, infrastructure resilience, preparedness and adaptation work by risk-management authorities in England.
sources.quality_effect: Adds flood-governance context while retaining national-report, investment, asset, scheme-output, residual-risk, return-period, local-strategy and reporting-year guards; programme delivery is not a site-specific flood model.

sources.source: Air quality statistics in the UK, 1987 to 2025 - Summary
sources.authority: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.verified_fact: The accredited release updated 30 June 2026 uses the Automatic Urban and Rural Network to describe monitored concentrations of major pollutants. It reports long-term improvement in nitrogen dioxide while urban background ozone reached the highest value in its series in 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds monitored-air-quality context while retaining station-versus-area, urban-versus-rural, roadside-versus-background, weather, transboundary movement, secondary formation, QA and no-unmonitored-parcel-interpolation guards.

sources.source: Air quality statistics in the UK, 1987 to 2025 - PM2.5 targets
sources.authority: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.verified_fact: The accredited 30 June 2026 release reports progress against the annual mean concentration target and population exposure reduction target for PM2.5 using defined target metrics and baselines.
sources.quality_effect: Adds particulate-exposure target context while retaining target-versus-limit, modelled-population-exposure, monitoring, baseline, spatial resolution and policy-progress-versus-individual-exposure guards.

sources.source: 2025 statistics on English coastal and inland bathing waters
sources.authority: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs and Environment Agency
sources.verified_fact: The official release reports that 417 of 449 measured designated bathing waters met at least the minimum standard in 2025, 297 were classified Excellent and 32 were Poor. Monitoring covers E. coli and intestinal enterococci during the official bathing season.
sources.quality_effect: Adds recreational-water context while retaining designated-site, bathing-season, sample, four-year classification, coastal-versus-inland and temporary-event guards; classification does not describe every water body or every day.

sources.source: Product Safety Alerts, Reports and Recalls
sources.authority: Office for Product Safety and Standards
sources.verified_fact: The live official registry displayed 3,561 product-safety reports, alerts and recalls when checked, with records differentiated by alert type, risk level, product category, measure type and recall or alert date.
sources.quality_effect: Adds current product-safety intelligence while retaining live-snapshot, report-versus-recall, product-versus-listing, risk-level completeness, duplicate-measure, border-action and no-sales-denominator guards.

sources.source: Statistical count of in-year work-related deaths where HSE is the relevant enforcing authority
sources.verified_fact: The quarterly HSE series covers RIDDOR-reportable work-related fatal injuries where HSE is the main enforcing authority and is updated as investigations validate reportability. It excludes cases enforced by local authorities or the Office of Rail and Road from the quarterly count.
sources.quality_effect: Adds near-current workplace-fatality context while retaining provisional validation, RIDDOR reportability, enforcing-authority, worker-versus-public, quarterly-versus-annual and exposure-denominator guards.

sources.source: Fire Safety Order: enforcement and sanctions for non-compliance
sources.verified_fact: The guidance updated 3 July 2026 explains enforcing authorities, inspecting-officer powers, non-statutory advice, statutory notices, appeals, prosecution and who may be prosecuted under the Fire Safety Order in England.
sources.quality_effect: Adds legal-enforcement semantics while retaining guidance-versus-case-data, advice-versus-notice, notice type, appeal, prosecution and responsible-person guards; legal powers do not measure enforcement frequency or building risk.

sources.authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_fact: The guidance updated 4 June 2026 supports local authorities, fire and rescue services and the Building Safety Regulator in enforcing permanent remediation of multi-occupied residential buildings with unsafe cladding.
sources.quality_effect: Adds regulator-role and escalation semantics while retaining guidance-versus-action, regulator jurisdiction, temporary-versus-permanent measure, funding-route and enforcement-outcome guards.

sources.source: Water and sewerage companies: EPA methodology for 2026 to 2030
sources.authority: Environment Agency and Natural Resources Wales
sources.verified_fact: Version C of the Environmental Performance Assessment methodology was published on 16 June 2026 and defines the future comparison framework for major water and sewerage companies, including updated metrics and a water-environment and security-of-supply delivery measure.
sources.quality_effect: Adds water-company performance methodology while retaining methodology-versus-result, company, metric definition, reporting period, revised-rating and pre/post-method comparability guards.

sources.source: Office for Nuclear Regulation annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official annual report, published 14 July 2026, documents ONR activities, accountability and finances for 2025 to 2026 and was laid before Parliament without national-security exclusions from the published document.
sources.quality_effect: Adds nuclear-regulatory governance context while retaining corporate-report-versus-incident, regulatory-activity, site, security-sensitive-detail and performance-output-versus-safety-outcome guards.

sources.source: Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
sources.verified_fact: The MHRA report laid before Parliament on 15 July 2026 provides an overview of regulator performance for 2025 to 2026 and is accompanied by a results-and-forecast report covering achievements and future projections.
sources.quality_effect: Adds medicines-and-device regulatory capacity context while retaining corporate-performance-versus-adverse-event, authorisation, vigilance, enforcement, reporting-year and forecast-versus-outcome guards.

sources.authority: Civil Nuclear Police Authority and Civil Nuclear Constabulary
sources.verified_fact: The annual report published 20 July 2026 covers armed-policing protection of civil nuclear infrastructure and nuclear material in transit. The associated official summary states that 95% of annual business-plan objectives were fully met and all required regulatory evaluation demonstration exercises were delivered.
sources.quality_effect: Adds critical-infrastructure protective-capacity context while retaining objective-versus-outcome, exercise-versus-real-event, protected-site scope, sensitive-detail and corporate-report guards.

sources.source: Grenfell Tower Inquiry government progress report: May 2026 summary update
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government and partner departments
sources.verified_fact: The May 2026 progress update reports implementation activity since the February annual report across construction regulation, fire and rescue services, response and recovery, vulnerable people and Phase 1 recommendations. It records the Building Safety Regulator becoming a standalone arm's-length body in January 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds recommendation-implementation context while retaining recommendation, commitment, milestone, consultation, legislation, organisational-change and implemented-versus-effective-outcome guards.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Building-remediation management information uses programme status, self-reported inputs and building-control sign-off states.
Drinking-water compliance samples, water-quality events, assets, companies and consumers are different units.
Flood and coastal programme investment and assets do not replace site-specific hazard and residual-risk modelling.
Air-quality statistics use monitoring stations and defined target models; unmonitored parcel exposure is not directly observed.
Bathing-water classifications cover designated sites and bathing-season samples rather than every water body and date.
The live OPSS registry counts alerts, reports and recalls and lacks product-sales or exposure denominators.
HSE quarterly fatalities have provisional validation and a narrower enforcing-authority scope than annual figures.
Fire and remediation enforcement guidance describes legal powers and regulator roles, not enforcement incidence.
Water-company EPA methodology changes must be separated from company performance results.
Regulator and protective-service annual reports describe governance and activity rather than incident prevalence.
Grenfell recommendation milestones and organisational changes are not proof of effective safety outcomes.
The uploaded 046 note remains non-canonical without matching task, heartbeat, claim and receipt evidence.
No existing candidate score, endpoint manifest or stored parcel value was modified.
